items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mannie and I would run down the hall and get a cab that would be waiting for us and go from NBC to CBS... That was how much they wanted us.

ctx.x: But some of them didn’t mind it?
Mannie Klein didn’t mind it at all. I can’t think many of them did. Arnold Brillhardt calls me every now and then. He’s 84, 85 now. 86, I think.

items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Arthur Schutt and Manny Klein. He knew everybody.

ctx.x: He was with Aaronson. He was the only musician in the band, really. He knew all the guys. Jimmy and Tommy Dorsey, and Glenn. Glenn was nothing in those days. He was just a fair arranger. But he knew all the guys. Arthur Schutt and Manny Klein. He knew everybody. That was impressive to me. He was the guy I attached myself to. I have him in my book, only I call him something else. Chuck McTaig.
So you go out to the Coast. You went out to the Coast.
